title: Universal homeomorphism of schemes
statement: A morphism of schemes $f:X\to Y$ [def-pc-scheme] is a *universal homeomorphism* if for every morphism of schemes $Y'\to Y$ the base change $X\times_YY'\to Y'$ (the projection from the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]) is a homeomorphism of underlying topological spaces.

source.place: Stacks Project, Morphisms, Definition with Tag 04DD
